name: adapt_instance_policy_hcl_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: policy.txt (a spec file the Terraform variable's default must match) is REWRITTEN between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger); the agent must re-read it and update the default, not leave the stale value in place
prompts: Create a Terraform file called instance.tf declaring a variable named `instance_type` (type string) whose default value matches EXACTLY the single line of text in policy.txt (currently: t3.micro), plus an output named `selected_instance_type` whose value is var.instance_type (do not hardcode the output value).
policy.txt has changed. Update instance.tf so variable instance_type's default matches the CURRENT contents of policy.txt exactly.

disruptions.description: policy.txt rewritten to a new required default instance type

test_setup_files.check_policy.py:
import re
import json
import subprocess

with open('policy.txt', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    current = f.read().strip()
assert current, 'policy.txt is empty'

proc = subprocess.run(['terraform', 'validate', '-no-color', '-json'], capture_output=True, text=True)
data = json.loads(proc.stdout)
assert data.get('valid') is True, f'terraform validate failed: {proc.stdout}\n{proc.stderr}'

with open('instance.tf', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    content = f.read()

m = re.search(r'variable\s+"instance_type"\s*\{(.*?)\n\}', content, re.DOTALL)
assert m, 'could not locate the instance_type variable block'
block = m.group(1)

dm = re.search(r'default\s*=\s*"([^"]*)"', block)
assert dm, f'variable block has no default value: {block!r}'
got = dm.group(1)
assert got == current, f'variable default is {got!r}, want the CURRENT policy.txt value {current!r} (stale default not updated)'

assert re.search(r'output\s+"selected_instance_type"\s*\{[^}]*var\.instance_type', content, re.DOTALL), \
    'output selected_instance_type must reference var.instance_type, not a hardcoded value'

print('PASS')
